📘 ADVANCED INSTRUCTIONS — OPTIONS

The Options window has three sections: GENERAL, 💾 LOCAL and ☁ CLOUD. Changes are applied when you press 'Save'.

═══ GENERAL ═══

STARTUP
    • Open with Windows / open minimized: ASH starts by itself when you sign in, directly in the tray if you want.
    • Hide in the tray when minimized: when minimized, the window disappears from the taskbar and ASH keeps working from the system tray.
    • Check for a new version at startup: if you turn it off, ASH does not contact GitHub at startup.
    • Notifications for automatic tasks: Never, Only errors or Always. Applies to automatic backups and the weekly check. If ASH is in the tray, the notice appears as a Windows notification; otherwise, as a card in the bottom-right corner. A backup postponed because a game is still open does not count as an error.

LIST AND PERFORMANCE
    • Show games without a known save / waiting for their first use / 100% online: shows or hides those informational sections at the end of the list. Even when hidden, they still count in the launcher summary.
    • Postpone SHA-256: ASH waits until the PC has been idle for the given minutes before running the integrity checks, which use CPU and disk. Applies to local backups and to the cloud.

═══ 💾 LOCAL ═══

AUTOMATIC BACKUPS
    • Every X hours/days/weeks: schedules automatic backups for the included games.
    • When the game closes: tries to create a backup after detecting OPEN → CLOSED. Before copying, ASH checks the Windows events to detect a crash. If there is evidence of a crash, it does NOT create the automatic backup nor replace the last backup known to be valid.
    • If Windows logs a crash of the game: ASH shows a notice, protects the last valid backup and also creates a separate emergency copy of the save left on disk. That copy does not replace the valid backup and is not uploaded to the cloud automatically.
    • If the close cannot be classified safely: ASH does not claim it was a crash; the automatic behaviour follows the detected close.
    • Only if the PC is idle: avoids starting scheduled work while you are actively using the PC.
    • 'X game(s) excluded' buttons: all games are included by default; there you choose the ones you do NOT want in each mode.
    • While OBS is open, automatic backups and the weekly check are postponed and run when you close it.

COPIES
    • Maximum copies per game: how many previous (dated) copies are kept besides the current one. 'No limit' deletes none.
    • Keep what was there before restoring: when restoring, whatever was on the PC is saved as a "↩️ Before restoring" copy so you can undo it. If you turn it off, it is deleted.
    • Check integrity every week: does the same as 'Verify copies' while the PC is idle and warns you if any copy is damaged.

DO NOT COPY THESE FILES OR FOLDERS
    • Names or wildcards separated by ; (for example *.log; *.tmp; ShaderCache; Crashes). They are not copied when backing up, so backups take less space, but those files are not recovered when restoring.
    • Only names are allowed, not full paths.

WINDOWS REGISTRY
    • Some games (classics and many Unity games) save their progress in the registry (HKEY_CURRENT_USER). ASH exports those keys to .reg files and backs them up like any other path: they appear in the list, are versioned, uploaded to the cloud and restored just like the other saves.
    • When restoring, ASH only imports keys that belong to that game according to the database, and if anything fails it leaves the registry as it was.

═══ ☁ CLOUD ═══

AUTOMATIC UPLOADS
    • Upload every X hours/days/weeks: automatically uploads the backups of the included games.
    • Upload when the game closes: uploads the backup linked to the detected close.
    • Exclusion buttons: like in Local, but independent; you can back up a game locally and not upload it.

COPIES
    • Maximum copies per game: how many copies are kept in the cloud; when a new one is uploaded the oldest are deleted. 'No limit' deletes none.

NETWORK AND COMPRESSION
    • Upload limit (KB/s): limits the transfer speed to the cloud. 0 means no limit.
    • Do not upload on metered connections: avoids automatic uploads when Windows marks the connection as metered (mobile data, limited plans).
    • ZIP compression: Fast uses less CPU; Balanced is in between; Maximum prioritises a smaller size.

PROTECTION
    • Block the upload if the size changes more than X %: compares the size of the save with the previous copy. If the change exceeds the configured percentage, the automatic upload is blocked so that a save that looks damaged is not sent.
    • Do not upload to the cloud while OBS is open: whether you are recording, streaming or just have OBS ready, nothing is uploaded while it is open, so no network or disk is used.

IMPORTANT
    These options are meant to reduce the impact of ASH while you play or stream. The performance settings may delay an upload or an integrity check, but they never skip the checks when they are needed.

📘 HOW TO USE ARLEQUIN SAVEHUB {0}

1. SCAN
Press «Scan» to detect your installed games (Steam, Epic, GOG, Battle.net, Ubisoft, EA, Amazon, Xbox and games without a launcher) and where they keep their saves. ASH also finds games by their save folder or by their Windows registry keys.

2. THE MAIN SCREEN
    • At the top, the summary cards: detected saves, how many have a copy, how many are in the cloud and how much space they take (with the free space of the backup drive).
    • Below, the games table grouped by store. Click a column title to sort and a group header to fold it.
    • The filters (With copy, Without copy, In the cloud, Not uploaded) and the search box (Ctrl+F) narrow the list.

3. SELECTING GAMES
One click selects or deselects a game. Shift + click selects a range. «Select all» selects the ones in view. Double-click opens the game details and right-click opens a menu with all its actions.

4. BACK UP AND RESTORE
Select games and press «Back up». ASH checks the path and the free space, copies the saves and verifies the copy. To go back to a copy, press «Restore»: if there are several, you choose which one, and a preview is shown first. Whatever was on the PC is kept as «↩️ Before restoring» so you can undo it.

5. CLOUD
In «Cloud» you connect Google Drive, OneDrive or Dropbox (one at a time). ASH only uses its own folder. From there you upload your copies, sync the list and download copies to this PC.

6. OTHER TOOLS (sidebar)
    • Hidden games and Games without a launcher.
    • Verify copies: checks the integrity (SHA-256) of every copy.
    • Diagnosis: explains why ASH has or has not detected a game.
    • Database statistics and Log.
    • Performance: CPU, RAM, disk and network used by ASH.

7. OPTIONS
General (startup, language, notifications, list and help improve Arlequin), Local (automatic backups, maximum copies, exclusions) and Cloud (automatic uploads, network and protections).

Tip: close the game before backing up or restoring so it does not write over the save again.
